help.title: Help & support
help.subtitle: Task-focused guides, keyboard shortcuts, and direct support — without leaving the portal.
help.noResults: No topics match your search. Try different keywords or email us below.

client.title: Submit and track requests
client.body: Open Requests to create work, attach files, and follow status updates. Pinned requests on your dashboard surface the items that need attention first.

client.title: Share files securely
client.body: Upload deliverables and references from Files. Everything stays scoped to your organization and is available to your CartShift team.

client.title: Review pricing and proposals
client.body: Pricing & Proposals holds active quotes. Open an item to review scope, approve, or request changes before work moves forward.

client.title: Invite teammates
client.body: Team lets you invite colleagues with the right role. Pending invites can be copied or revoked from the same screen.

agency.title: Run the workboard
agency.body: Drag cards across columns, bulk-update status, and filter by client. The workboard is the operational home for active delivery.

agency.title: Manage client organizations
agency.body: Clients lists every account you serve. Open a client to impersonate their view, review requests, or adjust settings.

agency.title: Monitor revenue
agency.body: Sales Dashboard summarizes pipeline and closed revenue. Pair it with Marketing Leads when you need source-to-close visibility.

agency.title: Configure agency settings
agency.body: Agency Settings controls branding, integrations, and defaults that propagate to client workspaces.

support.title: Still need a human?
support.description: Email our team directly. We reply from the same address for billing, access, and delivery questions.
